scope: Additional safe classroom experiment concepts only.

experiments.title: Sugar dissolving
experiments.focus: Show a familiar solid forming a clear solution in water.
student_observations: The sugar disappears into the liquid.
Some solids are highly soluble in water.
experiments.teacher_note: A classic first lesson on solutions.

experiments.title: Milk mixture
experiments.focus: Compare a food mixture with pure water in the classroom model.
student_observations: The liquid is not the same as pure water.
Mixtures can contain many tiny components.
Appearance alone does not define a substance.
experiments.teacher_note: Useful for mixture and composition discussions.

experiments.title: Orange juice mixture
experiments.focus: Show that a food liquid mixture behaves differently from pure water.
student_observations: The mixture may stay uniform or cloudier than water.
experiments.teacher_note: Keep the activity conceptual and classroom-level.

experiments.title: Solution and mixture review
experiments.focus: Review how clear solutions and everyday mixtures can look different.
student_observations: Some materials remain mixed but not fully dissolved.
